subject: Item difficulty parameters (Rasch) not centering at 0?

messages.author: fce3057c41a1ef7d
messages.subject: Item difficulty parameters (Rasch) not centering at 0?
parts:
Hey all!

I've only been using mirt a couple years. I just got hired onto a job where Winsteps is used to get item difficulty parameters. I compared my mirt results with their results, and noticed a shift in parameter estimates.

I checked the MEAN_1 by adding the argument pars = "values" and it was set to 0. In order to adjust my parameters so they were centered around 0 I had to adjust MEAN_1 upward. For example, if my average item difficulty was -1.7, then I had to enter MEAN_1 = 1.7. This resulted in an average item difficulty of 0. 

I checked this on two other data sets (ayala form mirt, and one data set included in the ministep program called bond4). Similar results. 

I've tried to include a folder of my r script, the data sets, and control files for winsteps (though running Winsteps is not needed because I include the results in a spreadsheet). 

Perhaps there is a simple answer/solution that I missed. Otherwise I would have put this on the mirt-issues page on Github. 

Any thoughts?

Grateful for all your hard work!
